entries.title: Activity-centric Scene Synthesis for Functional3D Scene Modeling
entries.actual_reading: Project abstract; targeted paper/supplement method reading from preceding turn; this turn complete agent.h, scene.h, modelInstance.h, activityDatabase.cpp and synthesizerGeneral.cpp lines200-640. Not all888lines, dependencies, or code execution.
entries.establishes: Activity/object bindings and learned placement interactions are prior. Source has an explicit score bonus for shared objects.
entries.limitations: Shared-object score code alone does not establish that every candidate path realizes multi-agent sharing. No claim of prior temporal-persistence parity.

entries.title: ScIntBench: Physical Interaction Plausibility in3D Scene Generation
entries.actual_reading: This turn methods3.1-3.4, AppendixB.2,B.3,C.1-C.7,D.1-D.3. No official system/simulator or original scenes run.
entries.establishes: Prescribed native-capability manipulation evaluation with reference-controller calibration; missing capabilities remain missing.
entries.difference: Current code measures planar resource reservation and reconstructs unchanged scene states. It does not validate articulation, dynamic physics or human use.
